title: C++: Quick Sort
description: Implement the quicksort algorithm using recursion.

steps.title: Quick Sort
steps.description: Write void quicksort(vector<int>& v, int low, int high) using Lomuto partition. Test with {10, 7, 8, 9, 1, 5}.
hints: int partition(vector<int>& v, int low, int high) { int pivot = v[high]; ... }
Elements less than pivot go left, greater go right.
Recursively sort left and right partitions.
